address: 72/1 Yaowarat Road, Talat Nuea, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: In Old Phuket Town, a red sign sits above the white façade; its Thai name in gold lettering declares: Delicious. The plump beef balls are packed with flavour; beef slices tender; bone broth fragrant; and the soft noodles are perfectly cooked. Arrive early for lunch before it runs out....
